$comment: The cloud emblem's two strokes on the 1659 x 948 master, as centre lines in master pixels: the inner hook (top stroke, U-turn, then the tail down to the left) and the outer C around it. Widths include about 8 px of margin on each side. Read by scripts/build-earth-plate.mjs (the emblem mask) and plate.ts (emblemDistance()). regionRange: plate heights of distance from the strokes that the mask's green channel spans.
